note: Apple's "Welcome home" launch event is on Tuesday, which is why Apple news dominates this week.

front.title: New Apple TV 4K and HomePod Mini 2 Pre-Orders Expected This Week
front.tldr: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says pre-orders for the new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini open this week, ahead of Tuesday's "Welcome home" event and an October 30 launch.

front.title: F1 Singapore GP: Verstappen Takes Comfortable Victory From Leclerc and Antonelli
front.tldr: Max Verstappen won Formula 1's Singapore Grand Prix for the first time, leading home Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli after fending off an early challenge.

front.title: 'Wildwood' Review: Laika's Ambitious Stop-Motion Epic Is Both a Technical and Emotional Triumph
front.tldr: A teenage girl enters a mysterious kingdom to find her kidnapped brother in Travis Knight's animated fantasy, voiced by Carey Mulligan and Mahershala Ali among an all-star cast.

stories.title: OpenAI's Dot and Meta's Muse AI Agents Compared
stories.tldr: Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dot are now competing directly as personal AI agents, with different costs and access between the two.

stories.title: AI Industry Debates Dropping NDAs to Ease Data Center Opposition
stories.tldr: On TechCrunch's Equity podcast, hosts debated whether data centre moratoriums reveal a communication problem for the AI industry, and whether dropping NDAs might ease local opposition.

stories.title: Executives Say Voice AI Hasn't Reached Its ChatGPT Moment Yet
stories.tldr: Industry executives say voice AI still misses important context cues, which can break the wider pipeline built around it, so the technology has yet to have its ChatGPT moment.

stories.title: Anbernic's Next Dual-Screen Handheld Has the Perfect Aspect Ratio for 3DS Games
stories.tldr: Anbernic's upcoming RG DDS handheld pairs a 5:3 main display with a 4:3 bottom screen, matching the Nintendo 3DS's dual-screen aspect ratio.

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: A Roadblock Clears for Self-Driving Trucks
stories.tldr: This week's TechCrunch Mobility newsletter covers a cleared roadblock for self-driving trucks, as AI takes a bigger role in transport.

stories.title: Efferon Wants to Eradicate the Devastating Toll of Pediatric Sepsis
stories.tldr: Battlefield 200 startup Efferon has built blood-purification technology aimed at reducing deaths from paediatric sepsis in children.

stories.title: Dawn Myers Is Making It Easier to Style, Detangle and Care for Curly Hair
stories.tldr: Richualist, one of TechCrunch's Battlefield 200 companies, is founder Dawn Myers's venture to make styling, detangling and caring for curly hair easier.

stories.title: New Apple TV 4K, HomeView and HomePod Mini: 16 Details Leaked
stories.tldr: Two days before Apple's "Welcome home" event, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has leaked further details on the new products set to be unveiled, including an all-new smart home hub.

stories.title: Apple TV 4K Getting A19 Chip and a Potentially Easier-to-Find Siri Remote
stories.tldr: Apple's new Apple TV 4K will use a standard A19 chip, up from the A15 in the current 2022 model, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports.

stories.title: Apple Plans Major iPhone Duo Retail Showcase, but Supply Will Be Limited
stories.tldr: Apple is preparing new displays and large numbers of demo units for the iPhone Duo's October 23 launch, but supply will be limited, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

stories.title: Bloomberg: New iPad Mini With OLED Display Will Be Significantly More Expensive Than Current Model
stories.tldr: The current iPad mini starts at $599 for 128GB. Bloomberg reports Apple's next-generation model, arriving later this month, may raise the starting price even as storage increases.

stories.title: Aaron Sorkin's 'The Social Reckoning' Bombs With $5.5 Million Opening
stories.tldr: Aaron Sorkin's Facebook follow-up opened to just $5.5 million. Bad reviews, David Fincher's decision not to return, and a focus on algorithms rather than AI are partly to blame.

stories.title: Quentin Tarantino Teaming With Sacha Baron Cohen on West End Play 'The Popinjay Cavalier'
stories.tldr: Quentin Tarantino will write and direct a West End play inspired by the grand swashbuckling epics of stage and screen, with Sacha Baron Cohen attached to star.

stories.title: Andrew Garfield Reacts to Oscar Buzz as 'Artificial' Gets Resounding London Reception
stories.tldr: 'Artificial' does not reach theatres until December, but Andrew Garfield is already drawing Oscar buzz for his performance as OpenAI's Sam Altman in Luca Guadagnino's tech drama.

stories.title: 'The Riverbank,' 'Elza' Top Rio Film Festival Awards
stories.tldr: Enock Carvalho and Matheus Farias's Locarno-winning 'The Riverbank' won Best Fiction Feature at the Rio Film Festival, with Eryk Rocha's 'Elza' taking Best Documentary Feature.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum Shines, Paul George Debuts as Celtics Thump Sixers
stories.tldr: Jayson Tatum impressed and Paul George made his Celtics debut as Boston beat Philadelphia in preseason, though Tatum faces far tougher, more physical tests ahead than the Sixers.

stories.title: Paul George Reflects on 'Extra' Nerves in Celtics Debut
stories.tldr: Paul George's first three-pointer as a Celtic swished through the net, capping a preseason debut with nerves the 36-year-old says felt different despite nearly 3,000 career threes.

stories.title: Patriots 45, Raiders 17: Drake Maye Dominates, Fernando Mendoza Makes NFL Debut
stories.tldr: Drake Maye threw for four touchdowns and ran in another as the Patriots routed the Raiders 45-17, a blowout that also featured Fernando Mendoza's NFL debut.

stories.title: Will Campbell Expected to 'Miss Some Time' After Knee Injury Vs. Raiders
stories.tldr: Patriots left tackle Will Campbell is expected to miss some time after suffering a knee injury against the Raiders, the latest blow to New England's offensive line.

stories.title: Mike Vrabel Tells Tedy Bruschi He Wants 2001 Patriots to Be the 'Blueprint' for 2026
stories.tldr: Mike Vrabel said he wants the 2001 Patriots to be the blueprint for this year's team, telling Tedy Bruschi they are a much-improved side from where they started the season.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli Could Clinch the F1 World Title as Early as the Next Race
stories.tldr: Kimi Antonelli could become Formula 1's youngest world champion as early as the next race, the United States Grand Prix on October 25.

stories.title: Hamilton Apologises to Ferrari for Overriding Strategy Call in Singapore
stories.tldr: Lewis Hamilton apologised to Ferrari after overriding the team's strategy call during the Singapore Grand Prix, a costly decision that cost him a possible podium.

stories.title: Lando Norris Accepts Blame for Clash With Oscar Piastri in Singapore Sprint
stories.tldr: Lando Norris has accepted blame for clashing with McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri during Formula 1's Singapore sprint race.

stories.title: Red Sox Prospect Anderson Among Fall League's Week 1 Top Performers
stories.tldr: Red Sox corner infield prospect Anderson was named among the Arizona Fall League's top performers for its first week of action.

stories.title: Sonny Gray Will Pitch Next Year, Not Necessarily With the Red Sox
stories.tldr: Sonny Gray, who had hinted all season he could retire, says he plans to keep pitching next year, though not necessarily in a Red Sox uniform.

finally.title: 'Monolithic' Concrete House Informed by Rock-Cut Monastic Homes
finally.tldr: Architecture studio Roomoor has completed Monastic Field, a concrete home within a temple precinct in Baleshwar that recalls the rock-cut dwellings of monks on the Deccan Plateau.
